description: This file implements a REST API server using FastAPI for a Resume Screening Assistant. It provides endpoints for uploading resumes, listing resumes, creating and listing criteria, ranking resumes against criteria, and listing candidates with their rankings. The code handles database interactions, text extraction, scoring algorithms, and API route definitions.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _normalize_db_json(value: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes the JSON data retrieved from the database, handling different input types including dict, string, None, or unexpected types.

methods.name: ResumeOut _resume_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a ResumeOut object, normalizing JSON fields.

methods.name: CriteriaOut _criteria_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a CriteriaOut object, normalizing JSON fields.

methods.name: RankingOut _ranking_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a RankingOut object, normalizing JSON fields.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _compute_score(criteria: Dict[str, Any], resume_extracted: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Computes a simple scoring metric based on required and preferred skills as defined by criteria, comparing against extracted resume skills.

methods.name: list_criteria(limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max number of criteria to return."))
list_ranked_candidates( criteria_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Criteria UUID."), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max candidates to return."), )
list_resumes(limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max number of resumes to return."))
upload_resume(file: UploadFile = File(..., description="PDF or DOCX resume file."))
